conviction_note: Nothing decisive and unpriced: the FY plan was held at Q1, the IFIS FY number (ord. 1,120m) sits on the plan (1,100m), no revision or other TDnet filing landed 10-20 to 10-29, and the Q2 special gain was disclosed in July; the small positive sum (+0.5) comes from a Q1 run-rate modestly ahead of last year's H1 path and an activist register (AVI ~36%, Bushido 8.56%) that gives a capital-return announcement a real but unsized option, offset by this name's sell-off at its last two H1 prints, so p_up 52 on a 3.3 scale gives +0.13.
bar: No H1 guide is published (kabutan 上期予想 '－'). Full-year company plan: sales 14,500m, OP 1,100m, ordinary 1,100m, net 890m, DPS 65 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=4347, held at Q1 per the 2026-07-30 短信). IFIS FY ordinary consensus 1,120m (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=4347), 1,100m equal to plan per Monex (https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/4347_20260730_act_20260730_153017_4). H1 bar used: last year's H1 ordinary progress of 34.3% applied to the 1,100m plan = ~377m; my H1 ordinary estimate ~390-420m. The bar is one consensus source plus the company plan, so sizes are kept small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position at or above 0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-10-28 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, from baseline). Margin ratio not available (kabutan shows 信用倍率 '－'). No skew exists. Register: AVI Japan Opportunity Trust held 25.16% (1,793,100 sh) at 2025-09-30 and bought 775,300 more (10.88%) in its prorated tender at ¥2,200 closing 2026-01-28 (https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/43470/140120260129541627.pdf); Bushido Asset Management 8.56% at 2026-03-31 (https://s.kabutan.jp/stocks/4347/news/n202604031007/). Free float is therefore thin (median 20d turnover ¥18.4m). priced_lean_pct -0.19 (run-up only). No crowded short to squeeze and no disclosed shorts building.

findings.finding: Q1 ordinary profit 280m beat the IFIS Q1 consensus of 230m by 21.7% with the FY plan held; segments show Education OP +17% (350m vs 299m) and the Studio loss cut to -6m from -22m, while the deconsolidated Broadcast segment earned only ~53m in last year's whole H1, so a Q2 near last year's 114m OP puts H1 OP around 380-410m against 358m last year and H1 ordinary progress of ~36-38% against 34.3% last year.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q1 beat itself (2026-07-30, 15:30) moved +0.75% close-to-close and -3.04% by day two; the 2025-10-30 H1 print, with H1 OP +33% YoY and the plan held, fell 5.08% (-8.82% by day two) (Yahoo chart closes).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: anyone can compute the Q1 progress rate from the 短信, and the stock has already recovered from 1,741 at the Q1 print to 1,974. What remains is how the Q2 quarter (seasonally weak: 114m OP last year, 43m two years ago) lands, which no monthly series shows. If the market had fully priced an H1 above last year's path, a pre-print run-up would be visible; the 20d run-up is a modest +3.8% and 5d -1.3%.
findings.independence: Segment numbers from the Q1 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260730/140120260716595484.pdf) and last year's H1 短信 (https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/43470/140120251010571566.pdf); kabutan's progress table (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=4347). All are readings of the company's own filings, so one source family.

findings.finding: The register is now activist-controlled in effect (AVI ~36% after its January tender at ¥2,200 was oversubscribed 2.26x, Bushido 8.56%), the company runs a standing 50% total-payout target with a 戦略検討委員会 of outside directors set up in July 2025, and it has announced buybacks together with an H1 print before (2020-10-30, 2021-10-27), so a capital-return item in the same TDnet batch is a live possibility that nothing in the price reflects.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not measurable on this tape for an H1 buyback; the last return surprise (the FY dividend raised 50→60 yen with a 65 yen guide, 2026-05-12) moved 0.0% next day and -1.44% by day two (Yahoo chart closes).
findings.why_not_priced: It is an option, not a fact: the dividend alone (65 yen x ~7.12m shares ≈ 463m) already meets the 50% total-payout target on the 890m net plan, so the policy does not require a buyback, and none was announced at the 2024 or 2025 H1 prints. If the market expected one, the stock would trade nearer the ¥2,200 tender price than at 1,974.
findings.independence: Payout policy from the 2026-05-12 dividend notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260512/140120260508520933.pdf); AVI holding from the TOB documents (https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/43470/140120251205515695.pdf); strategy committee notice (https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/43470/140120250520558427.pdf). Independent documents, one inference.

findings.finding: A ¥55m extraordinary gain from selling the CAG OSAKA Rainbow Six Siege division books in Q2 (company: impact on FY results 軽微), lifting H1 net profit against last year's 268.6m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock rose on the 2026-07-02 announcement itself (kabutan: 'ブロメディア反発 ... 好材料視'), so the gain was traded once already.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it was disclosed in July and traded then. It survives only as a small lift to the H1 net-profit headline; it is below ordinary profit and the company says the FY effect is minor, so it is sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: kabutan's report of the reaction (https://s.kabutan.jp/stocks/4347/news/n202607020631/) restates the same disclosure: one source.

findings.finding: Renaissance Toyota high school moved its main campus to a new city-centre building that opened 2026-09-01 and absorbed the Toyota-ekimae campus; Q1 investing cash flow already carried the relocation deposit, so Q2 Education costs may carry moving and double-rent expense, and the old site could bring a disposal loss.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior relocation-cost surprise to compare; Education is the profit engine (Q1 OP 350m of 262m consolidated OP before corporate costs).
findings.why_not_priced: The cost is an inference: the company has not quantified any relocation cost or loss, and the 2026-07-30 短信 listed no subsequent event and held the plan, which suggests it was budgeted. Sized small and kept because the release is the first document that can show it.
findings.independence: The Q1 短信 cash-flow note on the Toyota deposit (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260730/140120260716595484.pdf). It shows the same project, not the cost.

bar_hierarchy: Revision: unlikely; plan held at Q1, IFIS FY 1,120m sits on the 1,100m plan, no pre-release filed, and the company did not revise at its 2025 H1 print (it cut net only at the 2024 H1 print). Returns: no interim dividend; a buyback is a live but unsignalled option given AVI ~36% and the 50% total-payout policy. New-year guide: not applicable (H1). Quarter: H1 ordinary likely ~36-38% of plan against 34.3% last year and 37% two years ago, so modestly ahead of the company's own path.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Sale of 釣りビジョン (Feb 2026) and an equity-method affiliate (Mar 2026), both with standalone special gains
rejected_candidates.detail: Both notices say the gain is eliminated on consolidation (impact none or 軽微) and both fell in FY2026, so they do not bear on the consolidated H1 print.

baseline_tension: Agrees with the flat lean (-0.19) and the modest run-up; the strongest positive the release could carry is a buyback or a raised plan, I looked for both (TDnet, payout policy, register, revision history) and found an option rather than a signal, and the strongest negative is this name's habit of falling after H1 prints (-3.23% in 2024, -5.08% in 2025), which keeps p_up near 50.
lessons_applied: The Q1 run-rate finding rests on a progress rate anyone can compute from the last 短信 and lands inside a held plan: trimmed from +0.4 to +0.2 (the core table's 'inside what was guided' and LESSONS rule 1's logic applied to a positive), and p_up moved from 53 to 52.

Rule 2: I lean positive, not negative; I recorded in baseline_tension that I looked for both the strongest positive (buyback, raised plan) and the strongest negative; the capital-return, one-off and relocation findings were left as they were.
